name: Mannius Eight
description: Mannius Eight was a planet located in the Mannius system in Wild Space, in grid square I-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid. At one point it was explored by the Graf family. The planet included lifeforms such as octopoids which communicated by changing their skin patterns.
